scheme_note: Sep53 = Freighter signMessage, Raw = Phantom signMessage, Eip191 = MetaMask personal_sign; signatures are hex without 0x

hash_notes.evm_grant: keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256('PrimeSeatGrant(uint256 chainId,address safe,address seat,address key,uint64 start,uint64 end)'), 84532, account, seat, key, start, end)); End = same with start 0 and end 0
hash_notes.evm_safe_vote: Safe EIP-712 digest (domain chainId 84532, verifyingContract safe) with safeTxGas, baseGas, gasPrice zero, gasToken and refundReceiver zero address
hash_notes.solana_stellar_grant: sha256('prime-seat-grant' || domain || account || seat || key || be64(start) || be64(end)); domain = ascii 'devnet' on Solana, sha256('Test SDF Network ; September 2015') on Stellar; keys are raw 32 bytes
hash_notes.solana_vote: sha256('prime-seat-vote' || 'devnet' || seat || be64(valid_until) || sha256(program || be16(n) || n * (key || signer byte || writable byte) || be32(len(data)) || data))
hash_notes.paths: <wallet id>/prime:<evm|solana|stellar>:<account>; domain 0 for evm (Ecdsa), 1 for solana and stellar (Eddsa); payload is the 32-byte hash as lowercase hex
